name: Qwen3 model-size sweep preflight and tokenizer A/C smoke
purpose: Start the same-protocol model-size robustness extension for text-only Qwen3 checkpoints while keeping model-size artifacts isolated from the Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Item169 root. This item records verified candidate model IDs, the new sweep runner, and tokenizer-only A_cache versus C_incontext smoke rows for the first three target sizes.

commands.purpose: Verify accessible text-only Qwen3 model-size candidates before scheduling weights or vLLM servers.
Run the safe model-size preflight: Hugging Face manifest plus tokenizer-level A_cache versus C_incontext smoke on sudoku/futoshiki, without loading model weights onto GPU.

provenance.gpu_scope: GPU0-3 reserved for reproduction, but not used by this preflight because external CUDA processes were active on all GPUs during setup.

Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct, Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct, Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Instruct, and Qwen/Qwen3-14B-Instruct were not accessible under those exact IDs in this session.
provenance.resource_guard: Observed external CUDA PID 2114 across GPU0-7 and UI-S1 jobs on GPU4-7; no external process was killed or preempted. GPU exactness/vLLM runs are pending until GPU0-3 are clear enough.

decision.headline: The Qwen3 model-size sweep is now scripted, documented, and preflighted for 0.6B, 1.7B, and 8B tokenizer-level A/C budget rows. GPU KM-3 exactness and vLLM ToT/RAP/LFS runs are the next gates, not yet claimed here.

gate_outcomes.number: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B, 1.7B, and 8B all available with 1, 2, and 5 safetensor shards respectively.
Each of 0.6B, 1.7B, and 8B completed 16 trace rows and 32 budget rows.
No model-size KM-3 exactness result is claimed in this item.
No model-size ToT/RAP/LFS vLLM result is claimed in this item.

decision.next_step_routing: When GPU0-3 are clear, run STAGES=exactness first for 0.6B/1.7B/8B. If exactness passes under the chosen dtype/tolerance, launch one vLLM model at a time and run tot_rap_vllm_smoke plus lfs_vllm_smoke before full detached grids.
